test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the correct statement about Mayor?

options.text: Tenure of Mayors of cities in India is fixed for five years.
Mayor is elected by the Governor of the State.
Mayor is the second citizen of the Municipal Corporation after City Magistrate.
Mayor is the head of the Municipal Corporation.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Mayor is the head of the Municipal Corporation.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Mayor is the ceremonial and administrative head of the Municipal Corporation**
 
• He** represents the city and presides over corporation meetings.**
 
• The Mayor is the first citizen of the city.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The number of member councilors in the municipal corporation varies from 40 to 85.
 
• Mayor and Councilor are elected directly.
 
• The number of Municipal Corporation is 16 in Madhya Pradesh.
 
• The Mayor in Council is the main committee of the Municipal Corporation.
 
• The** Mayor of this committee is the ex-officio chairman.**
 
• The Municipal Council consists of ex-officio members of the Lok Sabha Rajya Sabha, six expert members are appointed by the Governor.
 
• Mayors are usually** elected by the elected members of the Municipal Corporation or directly by the people,** depending on the rules of the respective state.
 
• In some states, the Mayor's tenure is one year, while in others, it can be five years.
